name: smwgraphics-organic-fortress
title: Organic Fortress
description:
I'd figure since there aren't many organic FGs, I decided to post one here.
This also comes with my ON/OFF eye switches and a made ON/OFF organic switch. My MatGoP(Mario and the Gem of Power) never had this. Compatible with this BG and this layer 3 BG.
Also includes 3 blocks: one by HammerBrother and 2 by MarioE.
Also give credit to me as it took a lot to draw this.
